faq_heading: Homes near Cougar Creek Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cougar Creek Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cougar Creek Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cougar Creek Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cougar Creek Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Khalsa School Newton (0.3 km south-east), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.1 km south) and Westerman Elementary (1.2 km north).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cougar Creek Elementary

30 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cougar Creek Elementary in a straight line (21 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Khalsa School Newton, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Kennedy Trail Elementary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (2.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Khalsa School Newton (0.3 km south-east), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.1 km south), Westerman Elementary (1.2 km north), Strawberry Hill Elementary (1.2 km north), Cougar Canyon Elementary (1.3 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Khalsa School Newton, 0.3 km south-east of Cougar Creek Elementary.
